lanes.label: World Plate / Region
lanes.description: Establishing shots and region concept plates — the vertical city, the towers, the under-city, the failing lattice, the surface hazard regions, the landed ark, mood plates. Environments, not figures.

lanes.label: Cast — Gen-1 Android
lanes.description: The grounded Gen-1 android playable cast (Gutterjack, Ironclad, Scrap-Saint, Rustblood, Dockrat, Hushwire, Hearthframe, Rustgrave, Dustwhisper) and the protagonist Sere. Present synth head + plated torso, no bare skin.

lanes.label: Cast — Welded / Human
lanes.description: Welded cyborgs (flesh-and-machine spectrum, human face + flesh base, e.g. Gristle) and tower-born humans (fragile, sheltered, e.g. Wren). Rendered grounded-grimy, never clean.

lanes.label: NPC
lanes.description: Under-city and tower NPC roster across waves 1-3 — supporting cast, vendors, faction figures, betweeners.

lanes.label: Symbol / Relic
lanes.description: Faction iconography and sacred objects — the Communion martyr-cross relic, memory-core relics, decommission brands, faction marks.
